means: The key light is BEHIND the subject, pointing back toward camera. Not a mood word - a statement about where the lamp is standing.
does: Blows the background bright, drops the front of the subject into soft shadow, and throws a glowing outline around hair and shoulders. It is the reliable spelling on this model: where rim lighting describes the result, backlighting is a heavily trained danbooru tag and is what actually delivers the rim. It behaves close to GRAMMAR - it fixes the light direction for the whole frame, so a second lighting tag naming a different direction (harsh overhead sunlight, underlight, front lighting) is a direct contradiction and the model splits the difference into mush. One light direction per prompt.
reach_for_it: when you want a figure glowing at the edges against a bright window, doorway or sky - it is also the cheap route toward a silhouette without committing to a full black shape
used_in: studio/looks/blockbuster.json and sunset.json tag strings; studio/lighting/backlit.json; the rim_only option of studio/cards/anime_fx_silhouette_mode.json
example_base: 1boy, solo, male focus, short dark hair, plain jacket, standing, city street, daytime
read_it_as: Compare the SHADING, colour and line - not the pose or framing. Adding any clause re-rolls the model's conditioning, so composition moves between the two panels even at a fixed seed. An img2img pass from one fixed base image would isolate the tag properly; that is not built yet.
